scope: All ordered keep/drop pairs. In inherited_or_one_common_action mode: inherited rows plus arbitrary other-branch action if exactly one mapped branch is shared. In independent_branches mode: arbitrary actions for both branches, but each positive new block must avoid reading the opposite keeper branch before joining; a candidate is then checked jointly. All unchanged rows map drop to keep. In blank_window domain the initial window is zero, with arbitrary new exterior bits during closure; all_tapes starts from every window. Failures are bounded diagram failures, not counterexamples or lower bounds. Survivors require independent checking.
